title: An unchanged importer across two dependency upgrades
summary: One unchanged page importer exposes the effect of each Commons IO and Commons CSV repair on bytes, record counts and numbered fields.

change.description: One unchanged page importer exposes the effect of each Commons IO and Commons CSV repair on bytes, record counts and numbered fields.

notes: The independent JVM oracle covered 96 inputs on each revision. parent-parent mismatches were 48 for bytes, 40 for count, 68 for page. fix-fix mismatches were 0 for bytes, 0 for count, 0 for page. parent-fix mismatches were 48 for bytes, 0 for count, 48 for page. fix-parent mismatches were 0 for bytes, 40 for count, 40 for page.
